name: m5-forkvar-t8-contention

variantDescriptions.t8w8: 8 concurrent compiles, 8 warmup iterations (JIT mostly settled)
variantDescriptions.t6w8: 6 concurrent compiles, one per top-tier core of the M5 Pro, 8 warmup iterations

description: Are the bimodal forks at 8 concurrent compiles (`m5-kwu-t8-bimodal-jit`: ~11.8 s vs ~13.4 s per compile) a JIT trajectory or CPU contention? The JIT recordings showed no per-method signature beyond chance (forkvar PLAN.md).

Instructions per op from `xctrace:ipc`: if slow and fast forks retire the same instructions, the JIT is not the cause. `t8w8` checks whether a longer warmup removes it; `t6w8` whether fitting the threads on the 6 top-tier cores does. Build `1e85ab8eba` (claude/uniques-audit-2.13.x), the one the bimodal campaign measured.
